title: Family Affairs — They're Stupid, Aren't They?
original_title: 家庭の事情 馬ッ鹿じゃなかろかの巻
overview: Tonii is a salesman at a mortgage company, and although he is in a romantic relationship with Haruko, a typist at the company, they cannot get married because they have nowhere to live. Growing impatient, Haruko declares, “As long as he can support us, I’d even marry an old man,” leaving Tonii deeply troubled.
